sections.what_happened: [VERIFIED FACT -- Kyiv Independent, updated 07:56Z] At least six people in Kyiv city were injured (was five in the 1200-01 record), incl. a 14-year-old girl; two hospitalised. [VERIFIED FACT -- National Police via Kyiv Independent] In Kyiv Oblast, one person was killed and two injured; energy facilities damaged in Bucha and Obukhiv districts. [ATTRIBUTED REPORT -- en.h.ua brief, 4 sources] Chernihiv fully lost power after an overnight Russian drone attack; electric public transport suspended. [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM -- Zelenskyy via The Independent, Nov 7] 'Every Ukrainian power plant' has been damaged by Russian attacks. [CONTEXT -- 1200-01, unchanged] 172 Shahed-type drones (137 jet-powered) + ballistic missiles; 4 missiles and 149 drones downed/suppressed; hits at 24 locations; Northern Bridge damaged and closed.
sections.what_verified: 2 distinct declared-tier publisher families for the toll update: Kyiv Independent (T2) + Ukrinform (T2, STATE UA, carries the 5-injured figure and the Air Force summary). NOTE the toll conflict: NV and Ukrinform still report 5 injured in Kyiv city while Kyiv Independent's updated version reports 6 -- the discrepancy is recorded, not merged; the 6 figure is KI's update. The Chernihiv blackout has NO declared-tier family (en.h.ua and OSNT are undeclared) and does not count toward corroboration.
sections.what_disputed: Toll conflict inside the tiered record: Kyiv Independent updated to 6 injured in Kyiv city; NV (09:41+02:00) and Ukrinform (09:55+02:00) report 5 injured incl. the 14-year-old. The 6th injury may be a later admission or a counting difference -- unresolved in this scan. Russian MoD has not commented on the Kyiv strike in the sources checked. Chernihiv blackout: single aggregator line, no tiered confirmation yet.
sections.why_matters: Update to the morning's lead story, not a new video on its own: the bridge is the visual -- Klitschko's selfie video from the damaged Northern Bridge is the hottest clip of the morning (3,800 likes / 550 comments). Hard number: 6 injured, 1 killed in the Oblast, one whole city (Chernihiv) dark. Fold into the Kyiv strike video or a same-day update beat.
